36800.meaning1: stopped using gems and gold; not using jewels or valuables

examples.text: ghaṭikāro kho, mahārāja, kumbhakāro nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇo apetajātarūparajato.

36801.meaning1: fact of abandoning; mere fact of dropping; fact of shirking
36801.commentary: (VINa) dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte'ti dhure nikkhittamatte. sace'pi dhuraṃ nikkhipitvā pacchā āroceti, na rakkhati, dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte'y'eva pācittiyan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: paṭicchādeyyā'ti, imaṃ jānitvā codessanti, sāressanti khuṃsessanti, vambhessanti, maṅkuṃ karissanti n'ārocessāmī'ti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte, āpatti pācittiyassa.
na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, ettāvatā saupavajjo'ti vadāmi. yo kho, sāriputta, tañ'ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, aññañ'ca kāyaṃ upādiyati, tam'ahaṃ saupavajjo'ti vadāmi.

seyyathā'pi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucim'pi nikkhipanti, asucim'pi nikkhipanti, gūthagatam'pi nikkhipanti, muttagatam'pi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatam'pi nikkhipanti, pubbagatam'pi nikkhipanti, lohitagatam'pi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.

36803.meaning1: puts down; places down; lays down

examples.text: n'ābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ, n'ābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ, nikkhipissaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ, sampajāno patissato.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ chetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā caturaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ ghaṭikaṃ katvā nikkhipeyya

36804.meaning1: sets aside; lays aside; keeps; saves; stores (something in)

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sāmikā gandhaparibhāvite karaṇḍake nikkhipanti. yo'pi'ssa hoti anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato, so'pi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
atthi keci buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvaṃ nhāyanti vilimpanti ucchādenti peḷāya paṭisāmenti karaṇḍāya nikkhipanti āpaṇe pasārenti, tena ca gandhena gandhakaraṇīyaṃ karontī'ti?

36806.meaning1: (of feet) placing down; setting down; stepping
36806.meaning2: laying down or aside, putting down
36806.commentary: (ITIa) pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto'ti gacchantassa mama pāde pādaṃ nikkhittaṭṭhāne pād'uddhāraṇ'ānantaraṃ attano pādaṃ nikkhipanto. ubhayenā'pi ṭhānagaman'ādīsu avijahanto sabbakālaṃ mayhaṃ samīpe eva vihareyya ce'pī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi, appasaddā bhonto āgacchantu pade padaṃ nikkhipantā, durāsadā hi te bhagavanto sīhā'va ekacarā.

saṅghāṭikaṇṇe ce'pi, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gahetvā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho assa pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto, so ca hoti abhijjhālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākat'indriyo, atha kho so ārakā'va mayhaṃ, ahañ'ca tassa.

36808.meaning1: laid down; set down; put down
36808.meaning2: laid down or aside, put down, gave up

examples.text: atha kho devatā ca kosinārakā ca mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ… puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā puratthimato nagarassa makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ ettha ca bhagavato sarīraṃ nikkhipiṃsu.

36809.meaning1: put down; placed down; laid down (in)
36809.meaning2: laid or set down; thrown down

examples.text: chakkhattuṃ kho pan'āhaṃ, ānanda, abhijānāmi imasmiṃ padese sarīraṃ nikkhipitaṃ, tañ'ca kho rājā'va samāno cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyapatto sattaratanasamannāgato, ayaṃ sattamo sarīranikkhepo.

36810.meaning1: could be set aside; can be kept; can be stored; can be saved

examples.text: no c'assa pāripūri, māsaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya. tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya satiyā'pi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

36811.meaning2: should be laid down, should be given up

36813.meaning1: wanting to store; wishing to keep

examples.text: asu, bhante, puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitu'kāmo, yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā, yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā, yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya'pi, no'pi nikkhipeyya.

36814.meaning1: to set aside; to keep; to store; to save

examples.text: atthi, bhagavā'ti. atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā, bhikkhū āmantesi, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, akālacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarapaccāsā nikkhipitun'ti.

atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, āraññakesu sen'āsanesu viharantena tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitun'ti.

36815.meaning1: having placed down; having laid on the ground; having dropped; having deposited
36815.meaning2: having laid down or aside, having put down

examples.text: nikkhipitvā garuṃ bhāraṃ, aññaṃ bhāraṃ anādiya, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
so na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati, hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.

36816.meaning1: having kept aside; having left aside; having disregarded

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, sakaṃ cittaṃ nikkhipitvā imesaṃ'y'eva āyasmantānaṃ cittassa vasena vattāmi. nānā hi kho no, bhante, kāyā ekañ'ca pana maññe cittan'ti.

36817.meaning1: having dropped; having laid down; having given up
36817.meaning2: having laid down or aside, having put down

examples.text: nikkhipitvā garuṃ bhāraṃ, aññaṃ bhāraṃ anādiya, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.

36818.meaning1: having placed down; having dropped; having deposited; having set aside

examples.text: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ, satthāni nikkhipitvāna, māṇavā etadabravuṃ.
sutvāna corā isino subhāsitaṃ, nikkhippa satthāni ca āvudhāni ca, tamhā ca kammā viramiṃsu eke, eke ca pabbajjam'arocayiṃsu.

36820.meaning1: to be abandoned when going; to be left behind when leaving
36820.commentary: (SNa) sabbaṃ nikkhippagāminan'ti sabbam'etaṃ nikkhippasabhāvaṃ, pariccajitabbasabhāvam'evā'ti attho. (SNt) sabbametan'ti dhanadhaññādisabbaṃ etaṃ yathāvuttapariggahavatthuṃ. nikkhippagāminan'ti nikkhipitabbatāgāminaṃ. nikkhipitabbasabhāvaṃ hotī'ti āha nikkhippasabhāvan'ti.

examples.text: sabbaṃ n'ādāya gantabbaṃ, sabbaṃ nikkhippagāminaṃ, yañ'ca karoti kāyena, vācāya uda cetasā.

36821.meaning1: discarding; dropping; putting down; throwing away; casting off (of)

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ? yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvit'indriyass'upacchedo, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ

36825.meaning1: discarding; dropping; throwing down; casting off
36825.meaning2: putting down, casting off, discarding, summary treatment

examples.text: hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.
bhārañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi bhārahārañ'ca bhār'ādānañ'ca bhāranikkhepanañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha. katamo ca, bhikkhave, bhāro?
dissati, bhikkhave, imassa cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa ācayo'pi apacayo'pi ādānam'pi nikkhepanam'pi

36827.meaning1: liable to be discarded; which should be cast down

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, bhikkhū arahanto khīṇ'āsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā samma'd'aññāvimuttā, tesaṃ'p'āyaṃ kāyo bhedanadhammo nikkhepanadhammo'ti.

36828.meaning1: laying down the path; setting the procedure; outlining the steps

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi, yaṃ te, cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇāhi.

36831.grammar: abs of caus of ni √khaṇ, caus, trans (+acc)
36831.meaning1: having made dig; having caused to bury

examples.text: rājā pañcasate naggasamaṇake gāhāpetvā pañcasatehi corehi saddhiṃ rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇesu āvāṭesu nikhaṇāpetvā palālehi paṭicchādāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya

36835.grammar: prp of pass of ni √khaṇ, pass, intrans

examples.text: cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.

36836.commentary: (JAa) sadā nikhātā'ti niccaṃ jalitaayapathaviyaṃ kaṭimattaṃ pavesetvā nikhaṇitvā ṭhapitā viya ṭhitā.

examples.text: nārī imā samparibhinnagattā, paggayha kandanti bhuje dujaccā, sammakkhitā lohitapubbalittā, gāvo yathā āghātane vikantā, tā bhūmibhāgasmiṃ sadā nikhātā, khandh'ātivattanti sajotibhūtā.

36837.meaning1: fact of being dug; fact of being buried

examples.text: ek'okāse rathaṃ katvā, sajj'assaṃ hatthamuccito, sārathī khaṇatī kāsuṃ, nikhātuṃ pathaviyā mamaṃ.
saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.

vāsīhi tacchetvā nikhādanaṃ ādāya anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā lekhaṇiyā likheyya, lekhaṇiyā likhitvā pāsāṇaguḷena dhoveyya, pāsāṇaguḷena dhovetvā nāvaṃ kareyya, nāvaṃ katvā phiy'ārittaṃ bandheyya, phiy'ārittaṃ bandhitvā nadiṃ patāreyya.

36842.meaning1: (of something bad) suffers; experiences; undergoes; falls (into)

examples.text: madhuvā maññati bālo, yāva pāpaṃ na paccati, yadā ca paccati pāpaṃ, bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.
tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi. so tatonidānaṃ maraṇam'pi nigacchi maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.
chaḷeva caturāsīti, vassāni navutāni ca, bhusaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchittho, niraye katakibbiso.

36844.meaning2: member of the Jain Order, Naked ascetic
36844.commentary: (MNa) amhākaṃ gaṇṭhanakileso palibujjhanakileso n'atthi, kilesagaṇṭharahitā mayan'ti evaṃ vāditāya laddhanāmavasena nigaṇṭho.
36844.notes:
sk nir √grantha 'free from knots'
pāḷi ni √gaṇṭha 'tied down'

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca acelakā satta ca ekasāṭakā satta ca paribbājakā parūḷhakacchanakhalomā khārivividham'ādāya bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ ubbhaṭṭhakā honti āsanapaṭikkhittā, opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti.

36845.notes: Compare Sanskrit nir √granth 'free from knots' with Pāḷi ni √gaṇṭh 'tied down'

examples.text: pakudhako kātiyāno nigaṇṭho, ye c'āp'ime makkhalipūraṇāse, gaṇassa satthāro sāmaññappattā, na hi nūna te sappurisehi dūre'ti.
atha kho nīko devaputto nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

36850.meaning1: community of Jains; following of naked ascetics

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.
atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭ'āgārasālā ten'upasaṅkami.

36852.meaning1: Jain religion; doctrine of the Jains

examples.text: paññapetī'ti dasseti ṭhapeti. daṇḍāni paññapetī'ti idaṃ nigaṇṭhasamayena pucchanto āha. kāyadaṇḍaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ manodaṇḍan'ti ettha purimadaṇḍadvayaṃ te acittakaṃ payyapenti.

36853.commentary: (ANa) nigaṇṭhasāvako'ti vesāliyaṃ sīhasenāpati viya nāḷandāyaṃ upāligahapati viya ca nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa upaṭṭhāko.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodh'ārāme. atha kho vappo sakko nigaṇṭhasāvako yen'āyasmā mahāmoggallāno ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

36856.meaningLit: group of nine discourses starting with the discourse on Jains

examples.text: ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā

ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā

36859.construction:
ni + √ganth > gaṇṭh + a + ī
nigaṇṭha + ī

examples.text: dovārikaṃ āmantesi, ajja't'agge, samma dovārika, āvarāmi dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
idaṃ tassa adinn'ādānasmiṃ vadāmi. evaṃ kho, visākhe, nigaṇṭh'uposatho hoti. evaṃ upavuttho kho, visākhe, nigaṇṭh'uposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.

36861.meaning2: fast-day, day of purification for jains

36862.commentary: (MNa) amhākaṃ gaṇṭhanakileso palibujjhanakileso n'atthi, kilesagaṇṭharahitā mayan'ti evaṃ vāditāya laddhanāmavasena nigaṇṭho.
36862.notes:
sk nir √grantha 'free from knots'
pāḷi ni √gaṇṭha 'tied down'

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, mahānāma, samayaṃ rājagahe viharāmi gijjhakūṭe pabbate. tena kho pana samayena sambahulā niganthā isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ ubbhaṭṭhakā honti āsanapaṭikkhittā, opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sakamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā ciravippavuttho assa.

36864.meaning1: talk about market towns; conversation about small towns

examples.text: gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.

36866.meaning1: plundering of towns; looting of market towns

examples.text: te tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpesuṃ, tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā gāmaghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nigamaghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nagaraghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, panthaduhanam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ.

36867.meaning1: town raider; market town looter; town plunderer

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, brāhmaṇa, purohito brāhmaṇo rājānaṃ mahāvijitaṃ etadavoca, bhoto kho rañño janapado sakaṇṭako sauppīḷo, gāmaghātā'pi dissanti, nigamaghātā'pi dissanti, nagaraghātā'pi dissanti, panthaduhanā'pi dissanti.
dhātuso'va [dhātuso ayañ'ca paṭhamārambhavākye'y'eva, na sabbattha. tīsu pana addhāsu ca upamāsaṃsandananigamanaṭṭhāne ca idaṃ pāṭhanānattaṃ n'atthi]
samaṇabrāhmaṇā [samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā nigamanavākye pana sabbatthā'pi samāso'y'eva dissati]

36871.commentary: (VINa) gāmena pūjitaṃ gāmassa vā pūjitan'ti gāmapūjitaṃ. es'eva nayo sesapadesu'pi.

36872.meaning1: imprisoning in a town; confining to a town

examples.text: bandheyyuṃ vā'ti rajjubandhanena vā andubandhanena vā saṅkhalikabandhanena vā gharabandhanena vā nagarabandhanena vā gāmabandhanena vā nigamabandhanena vā bandheyyuṃ, purisaguttiṃ vā kareyyuṃ.

36873.meaning1: neighbourhood of a town; vicinity of a town
36873.meaning2: neighbourhood of a town; vicinity of a town
36873.commentary: (DNa) gāmasāmantaṃ vā'ti vijjācaraṇasampad'ādīni anabhisambhuṇanto, kasikamm'ādīhi ca jīvitaṃ nipphādetuṃ dukkhan'ti maññamāno bahujanakuhāpan'atthaṃ gāmasāmante vā nigamasāmante vā aggisālaṃ katvā sappi-tela-dadhi-madhu-phāṇita-tila-taṇḍul'ādīhi c'eva nānādārūhi ca homakaraṇa-vasena aggiṃ paricaranto acchati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ambaṭṭha, idh'ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imañ'c'eva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno pavattaphalabhojanatañ'ca anabhisambhuṇamāno kandamūlaphalabhojanatañ'ca anabhisambhuṇamāno gāmasāmantaṃ vā nigamasāmantaṃ vā agy'āgāraṃ karitvā aggiṃ paricaranto acchati.

36874.meaning1: from a town; living in a town

36877.meaning2: chain for the feet of an elephant

36880.synonym: apanidheti, āvuṇāti, chādeti, paṭicchādeti, pariguhati, parigūhati

examples.text: sañciccā'ti jānanto āpajjati. parigūhatī'ti nigūhati na deseti na vuṭṭhāti.
etaṃ te anumodāma, yaṃ bhāvaṃ na nigūhasi, khilaṃ pabhindasi pakkhi, ujuko'si vihaṅ'gama.

36884.meaning2: having covered up, having concealed, having hidden

36892.meaning1: catches; holds down; pins down; restrains

examples.text: nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya. daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷetvā osajjeyya.
so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggahitvā, gīvāya suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya.

puna caparaṃ, udāyi, mamaṃ sāvakā adhipaññāya sambhāventi, paññavā samaṇo gotamo paramena paññākkhandhena samannāgato, taṃ vata anāgataṃ vādapathaṃ na dakkhati, uppannaṃ vā parappavādaṃ na sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇhissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

36895.meaning1: to catch hold (of); to hold down; to pin down; to restrain

examples.text: imasmiṃ vitakkamūlabhedapabbe ṭhatvā vitakke niggaṇhituṃ asakkontena pana evaṃ niggaṇhitabbā'ti aparam'pi kāraṇaṃ dassento puna tassa ce, bhikkhave'ti-ādim'āha.

36896.meaning1: having held down; having pushed down (something with); having held (something) in place (with)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggaṇhitvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā, yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya.

36897.meaning1: having held in check; having restrained; having brought under control

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddh'ābhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
dhanañ'ca puttaṃ bhariyañ'ca, chaḍḍayitvāna niggatā, kaṭacchubhikkhahetū'pi, akicchāni nisevare.
